{{Quote|Within hours, similar reports were coming in from Sencil Corp on Churba, Reiber Manufacturing on Jeyell, and SGI Systems, Inc. on Druckenwell.|A news report by the Basic Edition of ''Nal Hutta Kal'tamok''|<ref name="Journal6" />}}
'''Jeyell''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Roche sector/Legends|Roche sector]], on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]]. It housed the headquarters of [[Reiber Manufacturing]], a company that manufactured [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] components until it was [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalized]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[1 ABY/Legends|36:4:20]].

==Description==
Jeyell was a terrestrial<ref name="Journal6" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Jeyell">{{CSWECite|II|161|Jeyell}}</ref> located in the [[Jeyell system/Legends|Jeyell system]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Roche sector/Legends|Roche sector]].<ref name="EAOC Jeyell" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Carbos system/Legends|Carbos]] and [[Roche system]]s, as well as<ref name="TEA Jeyell" /> the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector's]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Rearqu Cluster/Legends|Rearqu Cluster]], and served as a dividing line between the regions known as the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA Jeyell" />

==History==
{{Quote|In one fell swoop, the Empire has apparently seized the assets of the major manufacturers of black market assassin droid matrixes and mission-specific components in the entire Mid-Rim region.|A news report by the Basic Edition of ''Nal Hutta Kal'tamok''|<ref name="Journal6" />}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Jeyell housed the headquarters of [[Reiber Manufacturing]], a major manufacturer of [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] components. On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[1 ABY/Legends|36:4:20]], [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military forces]] announced the [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalization]] of the [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporation]] [[Bansche Tech/Legends|Bansche Tech]] on the<ref name="Journal6" /> world<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Chamble/Legends|Chamble]], with a [[Company/Legends|company]] of Imperial [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] establishing a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] in the [[Factory/Legends|factories]] situated near the company's corporate offices there. Within [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of the takeover, similar reports came in about Reiber Manufacturing on Jeyell as well as other Mid Rim companies involved in the underground [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] market. On the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]], the incident was reported on by an issue of the Basic Edition of the [[Nal Hutta Kal'tamok/Legends|''Nal Hutta Kal'tamok'']] [[NewsNet]].<ref name="Journal6" /> The nationalized companies were subsequently reorganized by the Empire into the [[Imperial Droid Corporation]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jeyell was first mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" segment of the [[May]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The segment was authored by [[Paul Sudlow]].<ref name="Journal6" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Jeyell [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square Q-8.<ref name="TEA Jeyell" />
